locations.name: Rourkela Steel Plant
locations.summary: India's first integrated steel plant to use LD (Linz-Donawitz) technology. Set up with German collaboration in 1959.

details.notes: First plant in India to use LD technology.

locations.name: TATA Steel Kalinganagar
locations.summary: Largest integrated steel plant in India, located in the Kalinganagar industrial cluster (Duburi, Jajpur).

details.notes: Anchor unit of the Kalinganagar industrial region.

locations.name: NALCO Alumina Refinery (Damanjodi)
locations.summary: Asia's largest integrated alumina/aluminium complex. Damanjodi refinery is fed by the adjacent Panchpatmali bauxite mine.

details.notes: Asia's largest integrated alumina/aluminium complex; one of the most modern globally.

locations.name: NALCO Smelter (Angul)
locations.summary: Aluminium smelter and captive power plant. Paired with the Damanjodi refinery.

locations.name: Vedanta Aluminium Smelter
locations.summary: The world's largest single-location aluminium smelter.

locations.name: HINDALCO Hirakud
locations.summary: Aluminium smelter co-located with the Hirakud captive power facilities.

locations.name: Utkal Alumina
locations.summary: Alumina refinery near Tikiri in Rayagada district.

locations.name: Infocity Bhubaneswar
locations.summary: Largest IT park in Eastern India. Hosts TCS, Infosys, Wipro and others.

details.notes: Largest IT park in Eastern India.

locations.name: Rajgangpur Cement
locations.summary: Site of India's first Odisha cement factory (established 1948). Odisha is the second-largest cement producer in India.

details.notes: First cement factory in Odisha. State ranks #2 in India in cement production.

locations.name: Paradip Phosphates
locations.summary: Major fertilizer complex at Paradip, alongside the petroleum-coke and seafood industries.

locations.name: FCI Talcher
locations.summary: Fertilizer Corporation of India unit at Talcher — coal-based fertilizer production.

locations.name: Sambalpuri Handloom
locations.summary: Famous Sambalpuri ikat and Tasar silk handloom cluster. Employs millions across rural Odisha.

locations.name: HAL Sunabeda
locations.summary: HAL Engine Division — aero-engine manufacturing. Components also supplied by L&T.

locations.name: Talcher Thermal Power Station
locations.summary: Largest power complex in Odisha — 4,600 MW. Coal-fired, fed by the adjacent Talcher coalfield.

locations.name: IB Thermal Power Plant
locations.summary: OPGC-operated thermal plant in the Ib Valley coalfield region.

locations.name: Hirakud Thermal Power Plant
locations.summary: Smaller coal-fired plant co-located near the Hirakud reservoir.

locations.name: Hirakud Hydel Project
locations.summary: Commissioned in 1956 as India's largest hydroelectric plant of its day. Built on the Mahanadi at Hirakud Dam.

details.notes: Was India's largest hydro plant at commissioning.

locations.name: Balimela Hydel Project
locations.summary: Hydroelectric station on the Sileru river in Malkangiri district.

locations.name: Upper Indravati Hydel
locations.summary: 600 MW project on the Indravati river — among Odisha's largest hydel installations.

locations.name: Rengali Hydel
locations.summary: Hydel project on the Brahmani river at Rengali dam.

locations.name: Upper Kolab Hydel
locations.summary: Hydroelectric station on the Kolab river in Koraput.

locations.name: Machkund Hydel
locations.summary: Hydroelectric project on the Machkund river, shared with Andhra Pradesh.

locations.name: Dhamra Solar Plant
locations.summary: Grid-connected solar plant on the Dhamra coast, part of Odisha's 10,000 MW solar target by 2030.

details.notes: Part of state target: 10,000 MW solar by 2030.

locations.name: Lanjigarh Solar Plant
locations.summary: Grid-connected solar plant in Kalahandi, near the Lanjigarh industrial area.

locations.name: Ganjam Wind Farm
locations.summary: Wind installation on the Ganjam coast. Part of Odisha's 2,000 MW wind target by 2030.

locations.name: Puri Wind Farm
locations.summary: Coastal wind farm in Puri district.

locations.name: Talcher–Angul Industrial Region
locations.summary: Thermal power, aluminium and coal mining hub. Hosts Talcher TPS, NALCO Angul, FCI Talcher, and the Talcher coalfield.

locations.name: Jharsuguda–Ib Valley
locations.summary: Thermal power and sponge-iron hub. Hosts the Ib Valley coalfield, Vedanta smelter and IB Thermal.

locations.name: Paradip Industrial Region
locations.summary: Major port-led industrial cluster — fertilizers, petroleum coke, seafood processing.

locations.name: Kalinganagar (Duburi)
locations.summary: Integrated steel and ferro-alloys hub. Anchored by TATA Steel Kalinganagar; close to Sukinda chromite-nickel field.

locations.name: Joda–Barbil
locations.summary: Iron-ore crushing and mineral processing hub. Sits on top of the Bonai-Keonjhar iron belt.
